about: Community plugin directory: plugins that live in their authors' own public repositories, with the compatibility information they reported. A listing is not an endorsement and nothing here is verified in game. tools/plugin_directory.py --check validates this file and the table in docs/plugin-directory.md; --write re-renders the table. Rules and the request process: docs/plugin-directory.md.

fields.name: Display name of the plugin or suite, one line without any of | < > ` [ ].
fields.ids: Every plugin.ini id the listing covers, data packs included: [a-z0-9_], 1-31 characters, unique across the whole directory, and not an id the host reserves (sco, host, menu, game).
fields.repository: Public source repository: an https URL without credentials, query or fragment.
fields.author: Author or organisation as they want to be credited, one line without any of | < > ` [ ].
fields.licence: SPDX licence expression exactly as the author states it (for example GPL-3.0-only or MIT). NONE, NOASSERTION and UNLICENSED are refused.
fields.languages: Plugin kinds and languages in the listing: any of c, cpp, csharp, lua, data.
fields.sdk_version: SDK release (x.y.z) the listing was built and tested against; never newer than sdk/VERSION.
fields.game_pack_version: Star Citizen game pack (x.y.z) of that SDK release when the plugin uses game.* services, else null.
fields.checker: Last sco-plugin-check result: full (default tables) and short (--short-tables), each pass, fail or not-recorded, and the UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) of that run, null only when both are not-recorded. Community listings need full = pass.
fields.offline: true: the author confirms the plugin follows sdk/docs/plugin-rules.md, including offline-only. Must be true.
fields.in_game: not-run (never run in game) or not-verified (no in-game verification is recorded by sco-core). There is no verified value.
fields.description: What the plugin does, one line of at most 200 characters without any of | < > ` [ ] (plain text: no HTML, links or code spans).
fields.listed: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was added or last updated.
fields.note: Optional one-line caveat, plain text like description.

first_party.name: sc-offline plugin suite
first_party.author: scubamount
first_party.description: sc-offline's plugins and shipped data packs: build placement, creative, crew, inspector, loadout, mining, NPCs, quantum, spawn, teleport, picker catalogs and optional local bridges.
first_party.note: First-party product plugins, built in-tree with the host from a pinned sco-core commit (SDK baseline 2.3.0), not from a published SDK archive. Some ship disabled (Discord presence is blocked pending review); per-feature in-game status is on the repository's own status page.

first_party.name: sc-mp private multiplayer co-presence
first_party.author: scubamount
first_party.description: Private co-presence for players running sc-offline, over sco.net: each game shows remote players as ghost entities it spawns itself.
first_party.note: First-party; the repository's CI runs sco-plugin-check on the plugin, but no dated result is recorded here.
